Manchester United reports seventh annual loss despite record revenue

Manchester United announced a net loss of £43 million for the year ending June 30, 2026, marking their seventh consecutive annual financial loss. Despite this, the club's revenue reached a record £677.6 million and is projected to increase further. Costs associated with player acquisitions and the dismissal of manager Ruben Amorim in January contributed to the financial deficit.
